title: Baltic anomaly history: lightning, smoke, NATO ships
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Baltic anomaly history: lightning, smoke, NATO ships, about unspecified at Baltic Sea anomaly, between Sweden and Finland, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Lightning has struck the object, smoke has been seen coming out, NATO ships are circling it, super strange.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks about a strange object said to sit on the floor of the Baltic Sea, between Sweden and Finland. He says lightning has struck it, smoke has been seen coming out of it, and ships from NATO, the Western military alliance, circle it, which he calls very strange and which would suggest the object is more than an ordinary rock formation.
